THE CONSULTANT

Hartfelt & Co. — greeting cards, est. 1987

Doug Hartman Jr. believes his father's company is "leaving growth on the table." Twelve employees. Profitable for years. Comfortable. That's the problem.

Your cut: 5% of everything above the run rate, plus milestone bonuses every week you beat Doug's target — and the target rises every time you hit it. Fall behind too long, and Doug starts wondering what he's paying for.

Policies hit hard, then fade. The culture adapts. The line demands more.
— nobody hires a consultant to hear "no"
